records.jp: どうしたの、愛央。<CR>そんな遠くを見つめちゃったりして
records.en_original: Hey, Ao. What's the matter? You look like you're miles and miles away.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Ao. What's the matter? You look like you're miles and miles away.
records.en: What's wrong, Ao?<CR>Why are you staring so far into the distance?

records.jp: たそがれてるんだよ
records.en_original: I'm just feeling a bit wistful...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just feeling a bit wistful...
records.en: I'm just feeling a bit wistful...

records.jp: なになに、元の世界が恋しくなったりした？
records.en_original: What do you mean? Do you miss our world?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean? Do you miss our world?
records.en: What do you mean? Do you miss our world?

records.jp: 違うよ。どっちかっていうと……逆かな
records.en_original: No. More like the opposite, actually.
records.en_auxiliary: No. More like the opposite, actually.
records.en: No. More like the opposite, actually.

records.jp: この世界にいられる時間もあと少しなのかなって思って
records.en_original: I was wondering how much time we have left here... Or how little.
records.en_auxiliary: I was wondering how much time we have left here... Or how little.
records.en: I was wondering how much time we have left here... Or how little.

records.jp: 今までのことを思い出してたんだよ。<CR>勇希と一緒にいろんなことしたなって
records.en_original: Just thinking about everything that's happened. And how we got to do all sorts of things together.
records.en_auxiliary: Just thinking about everything that's happened. And how we got to do all sorts of things together.
records.en: Just thinking about everything that's happened.<CR>And how we got to do all sorts of things together.

records.jp: そうだねー。<CR>いろんなもの作ったり、騒いだり、しゃべったり……
records.en_original: We did, didn't we? We made a lot of stuff, laughed a lot, talked a lot...
records.en_auxiliary: We did, didn't we? We made a lot of stuff, laughed a lot, talked a lot...
records.en: We did, didn't<CR>we? We made a lot of stuff, laughed a lot, talked a lot...

records.jp: 悲しいこともいろいろあったけど……。<CR>愛央やみんなと遊ぶと、それも忘れられたし
records.en_original: There were sad things too, but... Being with you and the other girls helped me forget about them.
records.en_auxiliary: There were sad things too, but... Being with you and the other girls helped me forget about them.
records.en: There were sad things too, but... Being with<CR>you and the other girls helped me forget about them.

records.jp: もっともっと遊びたいなあ
records.en_original: I want to hang out with you forever...
records.en_auxiliary: I want to hang out with you forever...
records.en: I want to play together so much more.

records.jp: そうだね……
records.en_original: Me too...
records.en_auxiliary: Me too...
records.en: Me too...

records.jp: 私、たまに考えるんだよね
records.en_original: Sometimes I wonder...
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes I wonder...
records.en: Sometimes I wonder...

records.jp: もし……もしこのまま、<CR>この世界に留まり続けることができるなら
records.en_original: What if... What if it turned out I could keep living in this world?
records.en_auxiliary: What if... What if it turned out I could keep living in this world?
records.en: What if... What if it turned<CR>out I could keep living in this world?

records.jp: 私は、ずっとこの世界で<CR>生きていきたいと思うのかなって
records.en_original: Would I want to stay here forever?
records.en_auxiliary: Would I want to stay here forever?
records.en: Would I want to<CR>stay here forever?

records.jp: ……正直、めちゃくちゃ分かるよ
records.en_original: I totally get that.
records.en_auxiliary: I totally get that.
records.en: I totally get that.

records.jp: だよね。勇希はそうだと思った
records.en_original: I thought you would.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought you would.
records.en: I thought you would.

records.jp: ここでの生活は、まあ、いろいろあったけど……<CR>結局のところ、やっぱり楽しかったんだよ
records.en_original: Life here, I mean, it's not without its problems... But it's been so much fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Life here, I mean, it's not without its problems... But it's been so much fun.
records.en: Life here, I mean, it's not without its<CR>problems... But it's been so much fun.

records.jp: うん。私もそう……
records.en_original: Yeah. I feel the same way.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I feel the same way.
records.en: Yeah. I feel the same way.

records.jp: みんながいて、暮らすのに困らなくて……<CR>まるで全部夢なんじゃないかってくらい、居心地がいい
records.en_original: I get to spend every day with my friends... It's so perfect it sometimes feels like a dream.
records.en_auxiliary: I get to spend every day with my friends... It's so perfect it sometimes feels like a dream.
records.en: I get to spend every day with my friends...<CR>It's so perfect it sometimes feels like a dream.

records.jp: 本当は、ずっとここにいたい
records.en_original: Honestly, I want to stay here forever.
records.en_auxiliary: Honestly, I want to stay here forever.
records.en: Honestly, I want to stay here forever.

records.jp: うん、あたしも。<CR>それが叶うなら、それでもいいと思えてしまう
records.en_original: Me too. If I ended up stuck here, I'd have zero complaints.
records.en_auxiliary: Me too. If I ended up stuck here, I'd have zero complaints.
records.en: Yeah, me too.<CR>If that could come true, part of me feels that would be fine.

records.jp: だけど、やっぱりそれはできないんだよ
records.en_original: ...But, I know that can't happen.
records.en_auxiliary: ...But, I know that can't happen.
records.en: ...But, I know that can't happen.

records.jp: ……思えば、この世界での暮らしは、<CR>長い長い夏休みだったんじゃないかって気がするんだ
records.en_original: Sometimes I get the feeling that our time here is nothing more than a long, long summer vacation...
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes I get the feeling that our time here is nothing more than a long, long summer vacation...
records.en: Sometimes I get the feeling that our time<CR>here is nothing more than a long, long summer vacation...

records.jp: でも、ここに留まってちゃいけないと思う
records.en_original: But I don't think we can stay here.
records.en_auxiliary: But I don't think we can stay here.
records.en: But I don't think we can stay here.

records.jp: あたしも、そんな気はする
records.en_original: No, I don't think we can.
records.en_auxiliary: No, I don't think we can.
records.en: No, I don't think we can.

records.jp: なんだろう……世界が保つとか保たないとか、<CR>そういう理屈の話じゃなくて……
records.en_original: It's not about whether or not this world is gonna fall apart, it's just...
records.en_auxiliary: It's not about whether or not this world is gonna fall apart, it's just...
records.en: It's not about whether or not this world is<CR>gonna fall apart, it's just...

records.jp: このまま、楽に過ごしてちゃいけないんだろうな、<CR>っていうぼんやりした不安みたいなものがある
records.en_original: I have a weird sinking feeling that this won't last forever.
records.en_auxiliary: I have a weird sinking feeling that this won't last forever.
records.en: I have this vague anxiety that we probably should not<CR>keep living so comfortably like this forever.

records.jp: なんか……夏休みみたいだ
records.en_original: It's like...like summer vacation.
records.en_auxiliary: It's like...like summer vacation.
records.en: It's like...like summer vacation.

records.jp: 夏休み？
records.en_original: Like summer vacation? What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: Like summer vacation? What do you mean?
records.en: Like summer vacation? What do you mean?

records.jp: 夏休みはいつかは終わる
records.en_original: It always comes to an end.
records.en_auxiliary: It always comes to an end.
records.en: Summer vacation always ends someday.

records.jp: 目を背けてた宿題にも向き合わないといけない
records.en_original: And when it does you have to face all that homework you've been ignoring.
records.en_auxiliary: And when it does you have to face all that homework you've been ignoring.
records.en: And then you have to face the homework you had been avoiding.

records.jp: 宿題、か……
records.en_original: Ugh, homework...
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh, homework...
records.en: Ugh, homework...

records.jp: そういえば私、補習受けないといけないんだった……
records.en_original: You just reminded me of the extra classes I was supposed to take back in our world...
records.en_auxiliary: You just reminded me of the extra classes I was supposed to take back in our world...
records.en: You just reminded me of the extra classes I was supposed to take back in our world...

records.jp: あー、やなこと思い出しちゃったね～
records.en_original: Oops, I brought back some bad memories, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Oops, I brought back some bad memories, huh?
records.en: Oops, I brought back some bad memories, huh?

records.jp: なんで勇希は楽しそうなんだよー
records.en_original: Why are you smiling, Yuki?
records.en_auxiliary: Why are you smiling, Yuki?
records.en: Why are you smiling, Yuki?

records.jp: あはは、そりゃ他人事ですから！
records.en_original: Ahaha! Because I'm not the one that has to do it!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha! Because I'm not the one that has to do it!
records.en: Ahaha! Because I'm not the one that has to do it!

records.jp: めんどいなぁ……
records.en_original: What a pain...
records.en_auxiliary: What a pain...
records.en: What a pain...

records.jp: 私けっこう頑張ったと思うんだけど、<CR>まだ頑張んないといけないのかー
records.en_original: I feel like I've already worked so hard, but it never ends. It's not fair...
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like I've already worked so hard, but it never ends. It's not fair...
records.en: I feel like I have already worked pretty hard,<CR>but I still have to keep working, huh...

records.jp: 応援してるよ～
records.en_original: I'll be cheering you on, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll be cheering you on, Ao!
records.en: I'll be cheering you on, Ao!

records.jp: ほんと？　全然心こもってない気がするんですけど！
records.en_original: You will, huh? Why do I feel like you're just saying that?
records.en_auxiliary: You will, huh? Why do I feel like you're just saying that?
records.en: You will, huh? Why do I feel like you're just saying that?

records.jp: ……はぁ
records.en_original: ...*Sigh*
records.en_auxiliary: ...*Sigh*
records.en: ...*Sigh*

records.jp: でも、やんないとね
records.en_original: But no matter how much it sucks, it needs to be done, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: But no matter how much it sucks, it needs to be done, huh?
records.en: But no matter how much it sucks, it needs to be done, huh?

records.jp: うん。あたしも……<CR>いろいろ、考えていかないといけないことがある
records.en_original: Yeah. I've got a bunch of stuff to figure out myself.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I've got a bunch of stuff to figure out myself.
records.en: Yeah. I also...<CR>have various things I need to keep thinking about.

records.jp: んじゃ……そろそろ、宿題片付けに行くか
records.en_original: All right, then. I guess it's time to get some homework done.
records.en_auxiliary: All right, then. I guess it's time to get some homework done.
records.en: All right, then. I guess it's time to get some homework done.

records.jp: おー！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Okay!
